items.label: GHOSTS N GOBLINS
items.why: Boot program at $01F8–$0303, with the numbered-file KERNAL LOAD helper at $02E5.

Execute checkpoint at $7148 hit once. That routine copies $4000–$6FF7 to $D000–$FFF7, where all 12,280 bytes match at handoff. Its source also contains the copy routine and trailing bytes above $6FF7.
Colour RAM data for the loading picture, loaded to I/O at $D800.
Bitmap and screen bytes for the loading picture. The loader selects bitmap mode and $D018=$39 before loading .3.

items.label: track 12, sector 3
items.why: First sector of an orphan two-sector bootstrap copy. It links to 12/13. The active directory entry instead follows 12/1 and 12/11; the active loader names .1 through .5.

items.label: track 12, sector 13
items.why: Terminal sector of the orphan bootstrap chain beginning at 12/3. Its payload ends in a duplicate numbered-file load stub; the active file chain excludes this sector.
